name: Harsh-O-Anand | Crowd Work | Stand Up Comedy By Harsh Gujral
description:
Roast of a Roaster 
This video is from a show I did in Amsterdam and never did I know that I would be at the receiving end of a funny roast. Anand Bhai just killed it with his witty responses and one-liners. For the first time, I had no answers and was happy. 
Do Watch and Share 
With Love 
Harsh Gu
